title: Sort and search
text: Multi-column sorting, a search box, and a filter row work on the client or through your server.

title: Selection and detail
text: Single or multiple row selection and expandable detail rows rendered by your code.

title: Grouping with totals
text: Group rows by any column and show totals per group.

title: Column control
text: Resize, reorder, pin, and hide columns, with a column chooser for users.

title: CSV export
text: Download all, filtered, or selected rows as CSV.
